summary: slcl is a web-based file manager designed to provide simple cloud storage through a browser interface. Written in C, it allows you to handle remote file transfers and organisation without a heavy runtime environment. As a lightweight self-hosted storage tool, it serves as a minimalist alternative to larger cloud synchronisation suites.
goodFor: This is a suitable choice if you need a low-overhead, resource-efficient file manager to run on constrained hardware or minimal server configurations.
watchOut: The project lacks tagged releases and has a zero star count, indicating very early maturity, minimal community testing, and a complete absence of historical updates. You should also verify the AGPL-3.0 copyleft requirements before integrating it into your environment.
deployNotes: Being written in C, it typically runs as a compiled binary that will need a reverse proxy like Nginx for TLS termination and persistent disk storage mounted for your files. You will also want to check whether it requires a local database or uses a flat-file structure for metadata.
